title: Lone Fisherman at Dusk
description: A shirtless man with dark skin stands in shallow water with his back to the viewer, holding a tattered blanket over his head and shoulders while carrying a woven basket. A weathered wooden boat rests on the muddy bank of a winding river surrounded by tall reeds under a dark, moody twilight sky.
